region.description: Regional prompt: --region <area>[::strength] <prompt>. Area = left/right/top/bottom/center/top-left/top-right/bottom-left/bottom-right/left-third/middle-third/right-third/top-third/bottom-third or x,y,w,h fractions. Repeat up to 8. SDXL/SD1.5 + Krea2/FLUX.3/Qwen-Image 2.1 t2i/i2i

stylize.description: Stylization strength (0-1000) · slider LoRAs coming soon

weird.description: Reserved: parsed so old prompts still work, no effect yet

repeat.description: Number of job sets to create

speedTier.description: Speed: draft | standard | quality. Draft uses fewer steps or a distilled variant, quality adds steps where the model benefits. Standard keeps the model's defaults. --steps wins.

draft.description: Draft-then-upscale: generate at reduced resolution fast, then auto-upscale the result. Use --draft_scale to control the reduction factor (default 0.5).

draft_scale.description: Resolution scale factor for --draft mode (0.25-1.0, default 0.5)

refiner.description: Refiner slot. Any action id (e.g. upscale_subtle, upscale_detail) auto-fires after --draft; x2_detail swaps the H3 video decode VAE to X2-Detail at generation time; sol_refiner reserved (CUDA box)

sv.description: Style engine: 2 = image style reference (chosen automatically for an image --sref)

cref.description: Character reference image URL or ID

profile.description: Not supported: reported as an ignored flag so the value stays out of the prompt

vb.description: Video variants per run (1-4). Renders one after another with different seeds, each as its own tile. Video ignores the image batch size.

packId.description: Workflow pack override (e.g. minimax, ltxv, ltx25, wan)

vmodel.description: Video engine for --video (ltxv | ltx25 | wan | minimax)

mossSpeed.description: MOSS-Image speed preset (partial-strength speed LoRA + banding fix, CFG 3, ER-SDE): off (50 steps) | balanced (14 steps) | fast (10 steps) | fast4 (10 steps, 4-step adapter) | turbo (MOSS-Image Base + full 8-step DMD LoRA, 8 steps, CFG 1, no negative prompt). Legacy 8 = balanced, 4 = fast4. Default balanced when the LoRAs are installed.

mossKrea2.description: MOSS-Image: Krea 2 graft LoRA (WAS r64, TenStrip's MOSSkr2 Krea 2 weights grafted into SFT) for a Krea-2 look with more fine texture. SFT presets only (ignored with --speed turbo). Krea 2 Community License.

mossPhotoreal.description: MOSS-Image: Photographic Realism LoRA (Civitai model 3021669, r128) for camera-like light, colour and skin texture. SFT presets only (ignored with --speed turbo).

deband.description: MOSS-Image: load the banding-fix LoRA (removes vertical colour stripes in smooth areas). Implied by every --speed preset.

motionRepair.description: MiniMax H3: add the Motion Continuity Repair V2 LoRA (flips, spins, fast action)

handheld.description: MiniMax H3: add the handheld shaky-camera LoRA

h3Flex.description: MiniMax H3: add the Pika H3 Flex fine-tune LoRA (Mellis, Inc.; MiniMax H3 Community License). Picks pika_h3_flex_fl2va_v1 or pika_h3_flex_ref2va_v1 from the graph family; strength 1 unless --h3-flex-strength is set. Default off.

h3FlexStrength.description: MiniMax H3: Pika H3 Flex LoRA strength (0-1.5, default 1; needs --h3-flex)

h3Speed.description: MiniMax H3 video: lightx2v Turbo step-distilled LoRA (strength 1, MiniMaxH3SigmaShift video 6 / audio 3, euler / simple, CFG 1): off | turbo8 (8 steps) | turbo4 (4 steps). Aliases 8 / 4; --speed 8 / 4 also works on H3 graphs. Picks the fl2v or ref2v LoRA from the graph. fast8 (aliases fasth3 / fast-8): FastVideo FastH3 distilled DiT instead of a LoRA (UNET swap, CUDA int8; fl2v = fastvideo_fasth3_8step_v2, ref2v = fasth3_omniref_8step; core-template recipe: SigmaShift 10 or 12 / 3, comfy kitchen attention + VSA 10%, res_multistep or euler, simple 8 steps). No-op on graphs that already load a speed LoRA (character / face swap). Default off.

lora.description: LoRA with weight (format: alias::weight, e.g. anime::0.55)

minimalism_maximalism.description: Krea 2 tap weighting tilt from minimalism to maximalism

controlnet.description: ControlNet type (canny, depth, pose, lineart, scribble, tile) or model filename

cn-image.description: ControlNet source image URL (or use --control in attachment mode)

cn-depthmap.description: The control image is already a depth map (near = white): skip Krea 2 auto depth estimation. Grayscale images are detected automatically.

pa.description: krea2 prompt adherence via text-projector gain (100 = neutral; turbo-safe CFG alternative)

grid.description: XYZ-plot: render one image per {a|b|c} wildcard combination (a grid)

clipskip.description: CLIP skip (CLIPSetLastLayer -N). SD1.5/SDXL/Pony/Illustrious only; 1 = off, 2 = common for anime/Pony models

tiledvae.description: Force tiled VAE decode (VAEDecodeTiled). Auto-on at >=2048x2048 or with --lowvram

notiledvae.description: Never auto-tile the VAE decode (named to avoid the --no/--vae prefixes)

vaetile.description: Tiled VAE decode tile size in px (implies --tiledvae; default 512)

lowvram.description: Low-memory hint: auto-enables tiled VAE decode (added by the memory preflight when free memory is tight)
